current.summary: The main bedroom. A black four-poster frame bed with a sage headboard cushion, an arched window-pane mirror above it, cage wall lights either side, a wooden-blade ceiling fan and a disco ball. At the foot of the bed a dark green velvet sofa; opposite, a TV on a dark chest of drawers with brass handles; a walnut wardrobe; an antique inlaid cabinet with an ornate gilt mirror and Sicilian teste di moro. Brass chandelier with globe bulbs. The room has its original features: an ornate plaster cornice all round, old panelled doors and built-in cupboard doors, a black-painted skirting band, and a beautiful patterned cement-tile floor (star and lattice design with a border, plainer dark tiles round the edge). Walls are cream and marked by the recent works: pencilled “TUBI DA 25” pipe notes, patches, a white access cover, and a broken section of cornice at one corner with an open hole. A cord and a cable are strung across the ceiling; one door is covered in filler patches awaiting paint. The French window opens onto the front balcony.

target.renderPrompt:
Edit this photo of a room in our house. Keep the exact camera angle and keep all the architecture exactly as it is — walls, room shape, windows, doors, beams, floor and fixed fittings. Do not add, move or remove anything structural, and do not change the furniture unless I say so below. Remove all clutter: tools, boxes, bags, dust sheets, loose cables, packaging, laundry and toiletries. Show the room finished and tidy.

Changes to make:
- Ceiling painted terracotta, with the ornate plaster cornice in the same terracotta.
- Walls painted a pale warm mushroom.
- All doors, door frames, the built-in cupboard doors and the skirting painted charcoal, matching the dark furniture.
- The cornice is complete and repaired; no holes, pencil marks, patches or cables across the ceiling.
- Keep the black four-poster bed, arched mirror, wooden ceiling fan, cage wall lights, walnut wardrobe, gilt mirror and the patterned tile floor, cleaned. Bed neatly made with linen.

Style: photorealistic interior photograph, natural light plus warm 2700K lamps, no people, no text or labels.

scope: Paint ceiling, walls, cornice, woodwork to the scheme
